description: A host starts the validated app only after activation; link previews render bounded text and a safe HTTPS link.
source:
<script lang="ts">
import { EmbedBlockView } from '@texuli/blocks/embed/renderers';

const blocks = [
  {
    type: 'embed-app',
    title: 'Project status mini app',
    startLabel: 'Start preview',
    height: 'md',
    app: { kind: 'app', name: 'status-mini', data: { status: 'On track', tasks: 12 } },
  },
  {
    type: 'link-preview',
    title: 'Read the release notes',
    description:
      'A safe preview links to the public release notes without fetching remote metadata.',
    site: 'docs.example.com',
    href: 'https://docs.example.com/releases/1',
  },
] as const;

function mountEmbed(target: HTMLElement, app: Record<string, unknown>): () => void {
  const content = document.createElement('div');
  content.setAttribute('data-example-embedded-app', '');
  const title = document.createElement('h4');
  title.textContent = String(app.name ?? 'Embedded app');
  const status = document.createElement('p');
  const data = app.data;
  const statusText =
    data !== null && typeof data === 'object' && 'status' in data ? String(data.status) : 'Ready';
  status.textContent = `Status: ${statusText}`;
  content.append(title, status);
  target.append(content);
  return () => content.remove();
}
</script>

<article class="demo" data-example="blocks-embed" aria-label="Embedded app and link preview">
  {#each blocks as block, index (index)}
    <EmbedBlockView {block} {mountEmbed} />
  {/each}
</article>

<style>
  .demo { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; max-inline-size: 42rem; padding: 1.5rem; }
  :global([data-example-embedded-app]) { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--tx-color-surface-raised, #f3f4f6); }
  :global([data-example-embedded-app] h4), :global([data-example-embedded-app] p) { margin: 0; }
</style>

import { defineExample } from '../registry.ts';

const component = 'texuli/Carousel';

export const carouselExamples = [
  defineExample({
    id: 'ui-carousel',
    title: 'Carousel',
    description:
      'A labelled carousel of fictional destinations with previous and next buttons and a slide picker that roves with the arrow keys.',
    tags: ['ui', 'carousel', 'keyboard'],
    component,
    props: ['items', 'index', 'label', 'children'],
    load: () => import('./CarouselDefaultDemo.svelte'),
  }),
  defineExample({
    id: 'ui-carousel-overlay',
    title: 'Carousel with overlay controls',
    description: 'The previous and next buttons sit on the inline edges of the slides.',
    tags: ['ui', 'carousel', 'variant'],
    component,
    props: ['controls'],
    load: () => import('./CarouselOverlayDemo.svelte'),
  }),
  defineExample({
    id: 'ui-carousel-autoplay',
    title: 'Carousel with autoplay',
    description:
      'Rotates every four seconds with a rotation control first in tab order; hovering pauses it, keyboard focus stops it, and reduced motion keeps it off.',
    tags: ['ui', 'carousel', 'autoplay', 'motion'],
    component,
    props: ['autoplay', 'interval', 'onPlayingChange'],
    load: () => import('./CarouselAutoplayDemo.svelte'),
  }),
  defineExample({
    id: 'ui-carousel-states',
    title: 'Carousel states',
    description:
      'No loop at the first slide, buttons without a picker, a single slide with no controls, and translated labels.',
    tags: ['ui', 'carousel', 'states', 'i18n'],
    component,
    props: ['loop', 'showDots', 'showControls', 'messages'],
    load: () => import('./CarouselStatesDemo.svelte'),
  }),
  defineExample({
    id: 'ui-carousel-rtl',
    title: 'Carousel, right to left',
    description:
      'Arabic labels in a right-to-left layout: the slides, arrows, swipe and edge buttons all follow the inline direction.',
    tags: ['ui', 'carousel', 'rtl', 'i18n'],
    component,
    props: ['messages', 'controls'],
    load: () => import('./CarouselRtlDemo.svelte'),
  }),
  defineExample({
    id: 'ui-carousel-dark',
    title: 'Carousel on a dark surface',
    description: 'The same carousel on a dark color scheme, using only token fallbacks.',
    tags: ['ui', 'carousel', 'dark'],
    component,
    load: () => import('./CarouselDarkDemo.svelte'),
  }),
] as const;
